name: Tm Flexible Selections
pitch: Filter your Qlik app with tiles, check boxes, button bars, switches, date ranges and more, styled your way.
question: How do I give users clear, good-looking filters for many fields in one place?
questions: How can users pick a year, a region and a date range at once?
How do I show which values are selected, possible and excluded at a glance?
How do I let users set a variable or switch which field a filter shows?
useWhen: Many fields to filter, each in its own fitting display.
audience: App builders who want filters that match their app's look and read well on every screen.
features: Ten ways to show a field
States you can read without colour
Switch the field a filter shows

featureStrips.heading: Nine ready-made looks
featureStrips.text: Start from Pills, Check box, Segmented control and six more looks, then change fonts, colours, borders and corners per part.
featureStrips.alt: Two filters side by side: rounded pills for region and size, and a check box list with excluded values struck through.

featureStrips.heading: The right display for each field
featureStrips.text: A long list gets check boxes and Select all, a two-value field a switch, a short field a button bar or a radio list.
featureStrips.alt: A check box list of categories next to a radio list, an on and off switch and a button bar of years.

featureStrips.heading: Fits light and dark themes
featureStrips.text: Selected, possible, alternative and excluded values keep their meaning in any theme, with marks and bars that stay readable.
featureStrips.alt: The same region and category filters in a light theme and a dark theme, with North and Helmets selected.

featureStrips.heading: Date ranges and variables
featureStrips.text: Pick a from and to date or a quick range, and set a variable with buttons or a slider, from the same object.
featureStrips.alt: Order date from and to fields with quick range buttons, Low Medium High buttons and a slider set to 60.

hero.alt: Filters for region, year, category, customer and currency with flags, North, 2024, Helmets and NOK selected.
hero.caption: Five fields, five displays, one object
